description: This file defines a React component called LineChart that renders a line chart using Chart.js. It manages chart lifecycle, resizing, and conditional rendering based on data availability.

classes.name: LineChart
classes.description: A React component that renders a line chart with configurable data, options, and size, handling lifecycle events and responsiveness.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes the chart and adds resize event listener after component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates or destroys the chart based on data changes.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Destroys the chart and removes event listener before component unmounts.

methods.name: resizeChart
methods.description: Adjusts chart width on window resize if responsive.

methods.name: initChart
methods.description: Creates or updates the Chart.js line chart instance.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the chart or loading/empty states.
